label: LuminaScale Edge Simulation
info: Simulates apartment lux and PIR sensors, applies 2.5 second motion debouncing, publishes telemetry, and acknowledges actuator commands.

name: 20 apartment virtual driver
PIR debounce 2500 ms
Set telemetry topic
func: const p = msg.payload; msg.topic = `luminascale/${p.buildingId}/${p.apartmentId}/telemetry`; msg.payload = JSON.stringify(p); return msg;

name: Apply and acknowledge
func: const c = msg.payload; const key = `${c.buildingId}/${c.apartmentId}`; const seq = (context.get(key) || 0) + 1; context.set(key, seq); msg.topic = `luminascale/${c.buildingId}/${c.apartmentId}/telemetry`; msg.payload = JSON.stringify({ eventId: RED.util.generateId(), deviceId: c.deviceId, buildingId: c.buildingId, apartmentId: c.apartmentId, timestamp: new Date().toISOString(), type: 'state', sequenceNo: seq, brightness: c.brightness, commandId: c.commandId }); return msg;
